climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Chardonnay sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.

blurb.text: A Bulgarian PDO for red wine from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot and Pinot Noir, and white wine from Chardonnay, Riesling and Misket Vrachanski. It covers nine communes, including Montana, Berkovitsa and Varshets.

sources.name: Candiago et al. 2022, A geospatial inventory of regulatory information for wine protected designations of origin in Europe, Scientific Data (product specifications as of 2021)
